title: Mid-August Oil Price Shock
statement: A massive price shock in mid-August was projected; it never fully emerged because the regime used creative resource management (SPR releases + naval escorts) to blunt the shock and stretch the runway into the midterm calendar. This prediction has been superseded by the SPR-runway-breaks-before-midterms mechanism (status set to 'failed' as the specific August shock did not materialize).
evidence_confirmed: UBS sounds alarm on oil price for rest of 2026

SUPERSEDED (Sept 3, 2026): The hard August price shock did not materialize as projected. The regime offset the crisis through strategic petroleum reserve releases and a naval escort surge — creative use of resources that shifted the pressure from an acute price shock to the chronic SPR runway breakage tracked under a separate prediction.
SPR official data now confirms reserves at a 44-year low (286.6M barrels, ~40% capacity), directly evidencing the resource-burn that averted the August shock but created the November runway crisis.
evidence_contradicted: Goldman cuts 2026 forecast after potential (rumored) deal
falsifier: Already FALSIFIED (status=failed): the projected mid-August hard oil-price shock did not materialize. The regime averted it via SPR releases + naval escort surge, shifting the pressure to the SPR-runway-breaks-before-midterms track. Not re-evaluated while it holds failed status.
forward_watchlist: NYMEX Brent failing to break $100 within the original window (falsified the shock).
Pressure migrated to the SPR runway: SPR weekly drain toward the ~290M cavern-damage floor is now the live successor signal.
A resurrected hard shock in the pre-midterm window would be carried by the SPR-runway track, not this one.
